extracted.intended_audience: general readers and mathematicians interested in Vladimir Arnold
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia article summarising the life, mathematical work, teaching style, awards, and publications of Vladimir I. Arnold.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lucid mathematical writing and pedagogy
rubrics_metrics.description: Arnold is well known for his lucid writing style, combining mathematical rigour with physical intuition, and an easy conversational style of teaching and education. His writings present a fresh, often geometric approach to traditional mathematical topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article records the standard criticism that Arnold's books 'are beautiful treatments of their subjects that are appreciated by experts, but too many details are omitted for students to learn the mathematics required to prove the statements that he so effortlessly justifies.' Arnold's stated defence is that his books are meant to teach the subject to 'those who truly wish to understand it'. He opposed excessive abstraction (e.g., Bourbaki influence) and emphasised connections to natural sciences; his style is therefore suited to motivated readers and experts rather than novices seeking complete formal detail.
